verdict.rationale: MX documents a single shared connection mechanism, the Connect Widget plus Platform API, across its connectivity products: verification/routing numbers, owner identity, balances, and account and transaction aggregation. Connections persist as a `member` that MX re-aggregates roughly every 24 hours. Together this implies one connection can feed several data products, but no evidence explicitly says a single session unlocks auth, balances, transactions and identity at once without re-prompting the user. missing for 10: explicit documentation that one connection/member serves multiple products without separate flows, details on requesting multiple products in one widget session, independent or hands-on corroboration.
